description: Stop a learn session, save what it recorded as a named flow, then export the flow with its pinned procedures to a bundle file (default .sitelooper/procedures.json in cwd). Closes the session's browser. Then call build_start with the flow name.

bundle.description: Bundle path, relative to cwd or absolute (default .sitelooper/procedures.json).

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

session.description: Browser session name (default "default"). Each session is its own browser and daemon.

name: save_flow
